reproduction.harness: All variants use one legacy/200 harness and MinimalGasReceiver. Candidate creation bytecode is loaded with vm.getCode and deployed using CREATE in the original order, preserving addresses and signed calldata.
reproduction.measurement: All 89 snapshotGasLastCall measurements use Forge --isolate. Write measurements include transaction intrinsic/calldata gas and refunds; read measurements are callee STATICCALL execution. Setup and harness gas are excluded. Deployment gas comes from actual Prague Anvil receipts, reverting to identical account state and nonces for each variant.
reproduction.environment: FOUNDRY_* and DAPP_* overrides are removed for isolated builds. Tracked sources, snapshots and fixtures are never modified.
